title: Errors, empty states and the paths nobody demonstrates

videos.script: Every demo shows the happy path. The item is available, the name is typed, the loan goes through. Nobody demonstrates what happens when the name is empty, the item does not exist, or somebody else got there first. {{happy}} A reviewer tries exactly those. They type nothing and press the button. They open an address that does not exist. They look at what the page says when the list is empty. It takes them thirty seconds, and it tells them whether you thought about anybody but yourself. {{reviewer}} This lesson lists loanbook's unhappy paths, shows what the early version did on two of them, and what it does now. Then the three states every list has, and where an error that nobody expected should end up.
